featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - November 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official November Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Tirana, traveling through the Balkan to end in Rijeka.

The event takes place on the **8th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P3QHIrvSHSpH2)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38307.1791459212.jpg)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Tirana** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121262-official-ets2-convoy-november-2026/)**!
featured.rule:
**Event Rules for Participants**  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Tirana.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.  

**Event Rules for Event Staff**  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

featured.description:
Some of our ghosts went missing from the pumpkin farm so we think they are hiding in some of the trailers. 
   We need your help to find all seven different coloured ghosts around the area. 
   These ghosts only come out at night, so the pitch black sky will add an extra challenge to locating them! 
   Will you be the one to find them the quickest?
   But beware: the cheeky joker ghost loves to play tricks and jump around the play area. 
   Can you find him before he jumps to a new location?  

 You can find more information on our [Blog](https://truckersmp.com/blog/349)

   The event will begin on **1st of November 15:00 UTC** and you have until **1st of November 19:00 UTC** to find all the ghosts.

📜 Reglas temporales

🔹 Reglas del evento para participantes:
Solo el personal del evento autorizado puede usar las siguientes etiquetas en su nombre de jugador: "GAAT | EM", "GAAT | ES", "GAAT | ET", "GAAT | Lead", "GAAT | Co-Lead", "GAAT | CC", "GAAT | Tail", "GAAT | MM", "GAAT | Media" o similares.

Está prohibido suplantar la identidad del personal del evento usando las etiquetas mencionadas.

Los participantes deben seguir las instrucciones del personal del evento.

Los participantes deben llevar un remolque y dejarlo en el punto final. (Excepto el personal del evento)
Están prohibidos los remolques dobles, triples, HCT y las configuraciones de carga pesada. (Excepto el personal del evento)
Los coches están prohibidos, excepto para el personal del evento que muestre una etiqueta de seguridad.
Está prohibido adelantar.
Está prohibida la publicidad. (Excepto el personal del evento)
Está prohibido moverse libremente por el servidor.

Los participantes del convoy deben ignorar los semáforos a menos que sea peligroso hacerlo.
Los participantes deben estacionar en sus lugares asignados. Si no tienen un lugar asignado, deben estacionar en el área de "Estacionamiento Público".

Los participantes solo deben abandonar el punto de partida cuando se les indique, de manera ordenada (uno por uno).

Los participantes que se retrasen constantemente deben permanecer al final del convoy.

Se aplican todas las demás reglas de TruckersMP.

🔹 Reglas del evento para el personal:
El personal no puede adelantar al convoy más de dos personas a la vez.

El personal puede circular en sentido contrario ÚNICAMENTE en carreteras con mediana. De acuerdo con la regla anterior.

El personal puede bloquear intersecciones y accesos a intersecciones para dirigir el convoy.

El personal puede estacionar fuera de los límites del área, siempre que sea en el suelo y no sobre edificios u otros lugares inapropiados que el personal de TruckersMP considere inadecuados.

Se aplican todas las demás reglas de TruckersMP.![](https://ibb.co/zVMMRfNb)

today.name: FIESTA DE LOS DECEPTICONS
today.description:
La atmósfera de Cybertron vibraba con un zumbido eléctrico de pura satisfacción. Los Autobots habían sido repelidos y la victoria pertenecía por completo a la facción de los tiranos. En la plaza central de la fortaleza, Megatron observaba la formación de sus tropas, su figura imponente iluminada por los destellos intermitentes de la maquinaria pesada.
A un costado, Starscream ordenaba a los Vehicons acelerar el paso. Una enorme carga de fuegos artificiales de plasma estaba lista para ser detonada. No eran explosivos comunes; eran cartuchos modificados con energón crudo, diseñados especialmente para pintar los cielos con los colores de la conquista.

# 🎃 **HAUNTED CANYON ROADS | GTLEGION** 👻

October brings a different atmosphere to the American highways — longer shadows, colder evenings and endless roads cutting through some of the most spectacular landscapes in the United States.

Join GTLEGION for an unforgettable journey through legendary canyon roads, dramatic rock formations and wide-open American landscapes. This public ATS convoy is all about the road itself: breathtaking scenery, iconic highways and the unique atmosphere of the American West during the Halloween season.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/8cnHffHK/c73bc424-8206-45d5-a057-e3d013ee0bd7.png)

* 🚛 Bring your truck.
* 🏜️ Take in the scenery.
* 🎃 Hit the road with us.

The canyon roads are waiting.

📜 **RÈGLEMENT DES CONVOIS – ETMP FRANCE** 📜

**Article 1 – Respect**
- Respecter les règles du serveur et les consignes du staff.
- Faire preuve de respect et de fair-play.
- Tout comportement perturbateur peut entraîner une exclusion.

**Article 2 – Préparation**
- Être présent **15 minutes avant le départ**.
- Respecter les places attribuées.
- Partir uniquement sur ordre du Leader ou du Convoy Control.
- Ne pas utiliser les pseudo-tags réservés au staff.

**Article 3 – Conduite**
- Dépassements interdits sans autorisation.
- Garder ses distances et sa position dans le convoi.
- Respecter les limitations de vitesse.
- Éviter les freinages inutiles et toute conduite dangereuse.

**Article 4 – Communication**
- Garder les vocaux clairs et liés au convoi.
- Insultes, provocations et discriminations interdites.
- Seul le Leader ou le staff donne les consignes de circulation.
- Limiter les discussions hors sujet pendant le trajet.

# 🚛 Guiding Line Auto | October Convoy 2026
## 🌍 Welcome to the Guiding Line Auto October Convoy!

Dear partners, friends, and members of the TruckersMP community!

We are delighted to invite you to our **October Convoy**, hosted under our new identity — **Guiding Line Auto (GLA)**!

Following our recent rebranding from Path of Freedom, we are opening a new chapter in our company's journey. While our name and visual identity have changed, our passion for trucking, friendship, and bringing the community together remains stronger than ever.

### 📅 Event Information

### **⛟ Date:** 31/10/2026
### **⛟ Departure:** Duisburg (Slots)
### **⛟ Destination:** Prague (Steinbruch)

Шановні партнери, друзі та учасники спільноти TruckersMP!
